source: https://www.openstreetmap.org (boundary=administrative relations in Ukraine with a katotth tag, admin_level 4, 6, 7; Overpass API)
_meta.note: code = КАТОТТГ (official codifier of administrative units) as tagged in OSM; name = name:uk where present, else name. Relations without a КАТОТТГ code are left out, and duplicate relations with the same code are kept once.
